articles.title_en: Time bomb or gold mine? Policy, sustainability and media representations of tropical peatlands in Malaysia
articles.title_cn: 定时炸弹还是金矿？马来西亚热带泥炭地的政策、可持续性与媒体呈现
articles.abstract_en: Tropical peatlands represent an acute site of contested development on the front line of global climate change and action. Media analysis reveals how and why these ecosystems are understood in the context of local and national discourse, and the implications of these representations for peatland policy-making. In this study, we provide an instructive account of media representations of tropical peatlands in Malaysia – a country home to 6% of the world’s tropical peat by area and 12% by magnitude of the peat carbon pool. Set against an examination of the policy context for peatland media representations, we analyse how this critical ecosystem is framed in Malaysian media, and explore how these representations cast light on current sustainability-related policy and management debates. Drawing on media framing methodology, we analysed three English language newspapers (News Straits Times, The Star and Borneo Post) and one popular news website (Malaysiakini) from 1995 to 2018. From a sample of 1359 news articles, we found four dominant frames: development, conservation/protection, sustainable development and fire/haze. Within these frames, a number of key themes emerged including ecological benefits, community livelihoods, threats to peatland, integrated management approaches, and the value of peatland research. Our findings also reveal a polarising representation present across the study period – peatlands portrayed as a ‘time-bomb’ of ecological destruction and as a ‘gold mine’ in terms of their opportunities for development. We argue that contrasting interpretations of the sustainable development of peatlands may serve to obfuscate rather than facilitate current peatland policy discourses. Finally, we conclude that the fate of Malaysian peatlands hinges on recognising the localised challenges faced by peatland communities. We urge policy makers to consider food systems transformation approaches to move beyond a vision that relies entirely on drainage-based development.
articles.abstract_cn: 热带泥炭地是全球气候变化与行动前沿的一个激烈的发展争议场所。媒体分析揭示了这些生态系统在当地和国家话语中如何被理解及其原因，以及这些呈现对泥炭地政策制定的影响。在本研究中，我们提供了马来西亚热带泥炭地媒体呈现的说明性叙述——该国拥有世界热带泥炭面积的6%和泥炭碳库规模的12%。在考察泥炭地媒体呈现的政策背景的基础上，我们分析了这一关键生态系统在马来西亚媒体中如何被构建，并探讨了这些呈现如何阐明当前与可持续性相关的政策和治理辩论。借鉴媒体框架方法论，我们分析了三份英文报纸（《新海峡时报》、《星报》和《婆罗洲邮报》）以及一个热门新闻网站（《当今大马》）从1995年到2018年的内容。从1359篇新闻文章样本中，我们发现了四个主导框架：发展、保护/防护、可持续发展和火灾/雾霾。在这些框架内，出现了若干关键主题，包括生态效益、社区生计、泥炭地威胁、综合管理方法以及泥炭地研究的价值。我们的发现还揭示了整个研究期间存在的一种两极分化的呈现——泥炭地被描绘为生态破坏的“定时炸弹”和就其发展机遇而言的“金矿”。我们认为，对泥炭地可持续发展的不同解读可能混淆而非促进当前的泥炭地政策话语。最后，我们得出结论，马来西亚泥炭地的命运取决于认识到泥炭地社区面临的局部挑战。我们敦促政策制定者考虑粮食系统转型方法，以超越完全依赖排水型发展的愿景。

articles.title_en: Where do people vulnerable to deforestation live? Triaging forest conservation interventions for sustainable non-timber forest products
articles.title_cn: 易受森林砍伐影响的人群居住在哪里？为可持续非木材林产品对森林保护干预措施进行分类
articles.abstract_en: Rural households in developing countries often depend on non-timber forest products (NTFPs), including foods, traditional medicines, fuelwood, fodder, and construction and craft materials such as bamboo and rattan, for their livelihoods, but the forests that supply NTFPs are subject to competition from other land uses. NTFP collectors who are unable to sustain their livelihoods because of changes caused in the NTFP collection environment by deforestation and degradation may even convert surrounding forests to agricultural land to compensate for their reduced incomes. This feedback loop of deforestation and degradation can create further conflicts among natural resource users and undermine long-term development goals. Here, we aimed to advance the discussion of forest conservation interventions in protected areas in developing countries—particularly the discussion of patrolling strategies in and around existing wildlife sanctuaries—by presenting a new approach that uses the case of NTFP collection and a human geography perspective. We used a structured questionnaire composed of closed questions to measure the awareness of village households of the impacts of deforestation and/or illegal extraction of trees on NTFP collection over a short period of time (2014–2016) near the Prey Long Wildlife Sanctuary in the eastern part of the Kampong Thom Province, Cambodia. Our survey was based on the conceptual framework of Bohensky and Lynam (Ecol. Soc. 10, 11; 2005) that people in complex adaptive systems change their behaviour after becoming aware of the impact or consequences of a change. The probability of a village having an affected household (i.e., a household that was aware of the impact) was predicted by using generalized linear mixed models. By using identified geospatial indicators of environmental and socioeconomic aspects, including distance between the village and the wildlife sanctuary, size of deforested area per capita in 2014–2016 within a 10-km radius of the village and proportion of households in the village that collect NTFPs for cash income, we predicted the spatial distribution of villages with affected NTFP-collecting households. Priority areas for NTFP collection were then mapped with reference to the identified indicators. By using these results, we present an approach to breaking the deforestation feedback loop by identifying priority areas for patrolling and other forest conservation interventions in the wildlife sanctuary.
articles.abstract_cn: 发展中国家的农村家庭通常依赖非木材林产品（NTFPs），包括食品、传统药物、薪柴、饲料以及竹藤等建筑和手工艺材料，以维持生计，但供应NTFPs的森林面临来自其他土地用途的竞争。由于森林砍伐和退化导致NTFP采集环境发生变化，无法维持生计的NTFP采集者甚至可能将周边森林转为农业用地，以弥补收入减少。这种森林砍伐和退化的反馈循环可能加剧自然资源使用者之间的冲突，并破坏长期发展目标。在此，我们旨在通过提出一种新方法，利用NTFP采集案例和人文地理学视角，推进发展中国家保护区森林保护干预措施的讨论，特别是现有野生动物保护区内外巡逻策略的讨论。我们使用由封闭式问题组成的结构化问卷，在柬埔寨磅同省东部Prey Long野生动物保护区附近，测量了村庄家庭在短期内（2014-2016年）对森林砍伐和/或非法采伐树木对NTFP采集影响的认知。我们的调查基于Bohensky和Lynam（Ecol. Soc. 10, 11; 2005）的概念框架，即复杂适应系统中的人们在意识到变化的影响或后果后会改变行为。使用广义线性混合模型预测村庄拥有受影响家庭（即意识到影响的家庭）的概率。通过使用已识别的环境和社会经济方面的地理空间指标，包括村庄与野生动物保护区之间的距离、2014-2016年村庄10公里半径内人均森林砍伐面积以及村庄中采集NTFPs用于现金收入的家庭比例，我们预测了拥有受影响NTFP采集家庭的村庄的空间分布。然后参考已识别的指标绘制NTFP采集优先区域。利用这些结果，我们提出了一种通过识别野生动物保护区巡逻和其他森林保护干预措施的优先区域来打破森林砍伐反馈循环的方法。

articles.title_en: Characterization of potential Spanish territories for creating a national network associated with the Globally Important Agricultural Heritage Systems
articles.title_cn: 西班牙潜在领土特征分析：建立与全球重要农业文化遗产系统相关的国家网络
articles.abstract_en: The interest in conserving the world's agricultural heritage involves recognizing and protecting traditional farming systems as a source of learning that could help face the challenge of climate change. For this reason, since 2022, the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), through the Globally Important Agricultural Heritage Systems (GIAHS) program, promotes the initiative to identify and safeguard potential sites with agricultural systems, associated with their landscapes, biodiversity, traditional knowledge, and culture. In that context, this study aims to identify and quantify the traditional agricultural systems in the Spanish territory, under the GIAHS criteria. It offers an initial approach to potential sites for setting up a national network and for increasing proposals for designating GIAHS sites. The methodology consisted of four stages: the first was a literature review and identification of agroecosystems sites, the second was a characterization based on GIAHS criteria, the third was a spatial distribution analysis, and the fourth was a relevance classification and recognition of potential sites. The results showed that from a list of 173 Spanish sites, 50 potential agroecosystems were identified. 15 of them were classified with very high potential, confirming the potential for the creation of a national network of agricultural sites.
articles.abstract_cn: 保护世界农业遗产的兴趣涉及承认和保护传统农业系统，将其作为应对气候变化挑战的学习来源。因此，自2022年起，联合国粮食及农业组织（FAO）通过全球重要农业文化遗产系统（GIAHS）计划，推动识别和保护具有农业系统、相关景观、生物多样性、传统知识和文化的潜在遗址。在此背景下，本研究旨在根据GIAHS标准，识别和量化西班牙领土上的传统农业系统。它为建立国家网络和增加GIAHS遗址提名提案提供了初步方法。方法包括四个阶段：第一阶段是文献回顾和农业生态系统遗址识别，第二阶段是基于GIAHS标准的特征描述，第三阶段是空间分布分析，第四阶段是相关性分类和潜在遗址识别。结果显示，从173个西班牙遗址列表中，识别出50个潜在农业生态系统。其中15个被归类为具有极高潜力，证实了建立国家农业遗址网络的潜力。

articles.title_en: Farmers’ attitudes towards, and intentions to adopt, agroforestry on farms in lowland South-East and East England
articles.title_cn: 英格兰东南部和东部低地农民对农林业的态度及采用意愿
articles.abstract_en: Agroforestry (AF) is a land use that incorporates growing trees into agricultural crops and/or livestock production on the same piece of land. Due to tree cover and growth, AF has the potential to generate additional products, enhance biogenic carbon capture and storage, reduce soil erosion and surface water run-off and improve soil structure and fertility. These effects are likely to improve farmers’ financial return with minimal land loss to agricultural production. To date, there has been very little uptake of AF in the UK despite awareness of these benefits and increasing policy support. This suggests that there are barriers to adopting AF that policy, or market developments, have yet to address. This study set out to identify these barriers, along with potential drivers to further uptake of AF in South-East and East lowland England by means of a survey of 224 farmers and landowners in 2019 covering a range of farm sizes and types. Of those farmers who said they might consider planting small areas of AF, small woods and plantations were the preferred option. Silvo-arable AF was preferred to silvo-pastoral AF. If raised to the regional level, this could take up to some 5 % of the total farmed area. Financial reasons were behind some of the reluctance to plant, as was the view that trees might interfere with other farm operations. Farmers might need both planting grants and maintenance payments to help the UK Government reach their woodland planting goal to achieve the UK net-zero target by 2050.
articles.abstract_cn: 农林业（AF）是一种在同一块土地上将树木种植纳入农作物和/或牲畜生产的土地利用方式。由于树木覆盖和生长，农林业有潜力产生额外产品，增强生物碳捕获和储存，减少土壤侵蚀和地表径流，并改善土壤结构和肥力。这些效应可能以最小的农业生产土地损失提高农民的经济回报。迄今为止，尽管意识到这些好处且政策支持日益增加，英国对农林业的采用仍然很少。这表明存在政策或市场发展尚未解决的采用农林业的障碍。本研究旨在通过2019年对224名农民和土地所有者的调查，涵盖不同农场规模和类型，识别这些障碍以及进一步在英格兰东南部和东部低地采用农林业的潜在驱动因素。在表示可能考虑种植小块农林业的农民中，小树林和人工林是首选。林农复合系统优于林牧复合系统。如果提升到区域层面，这可能占农业总面积的5%。一些不愿种植的原因涉及经济因素，以及认为树木可能干扰其他农业经营的观点。农民可能需要种植补贴和维护费用，以帮助英国政府实现其植树目标，从而在2050年实现英国净零排放目标。

articles.title_en: Land and investment dynamics along Brazil’s ‘final’ frontier: The financialization of the Matopiba at a political crossroads
articles.title_cn: 巴西“最后”边疆的土地与投资动态：政治十字路口的马托皮巴金融化
articles.abstract_en: The Cerrado biome has become a driving economic force in Brazil, gaining international attention as the newest and ‘final’ agriculture frontier of the largest South American country. Spanning 10 states and nearly 2 million square kilometers, the biome accounts for nearly a quarter of the country’s national territory and more than half of its soy production. The Cerrado harbors the Matopiba plan, one of the most recent examples of state-led support directed towards the expansion of frontiers and the financialization of agriculture. Drawing on fieldwork (2016–2017), this article discusses land grabbing and the process of financialization in the Matopiba, a sub-region comprising one third of the area of the Cerrado. The processes analyzed herein are at once global in character and yet inevitably situated within the socio-political Brazilian context defined by the last three national administrations as well as the prospects offered by the current government, elected in 2022 and sworn into office in 2023. Considering the longstanding presence of capital in Brazilian agribusiness, the present study analyzes how foreign individuals have successfully leveraged knowledge of local land dynamics and positioned themselves as intermediaries to institutional investors. As a result, these actors have in effect facilitated and fomented processes of financialization in the region. This shift towards financialization is considered within a current political and economic context that risks further accelerating the entrance of foreign and transnational capital into the Brazilian countryside, exacerbating existing conflicts surrounding land and territorial rights in the Cerrado.
articles.abstract_cn: 塞拉多生物群落已成为巴西经济增长的驱动力，作为这个南美最大国家最新且“最后”的农业边疆而受到国际关注。该生物群落横跨10个州，面积近2万平方公里，占该国国土面积近四分之一，大豆产量占全国一半以上。塞拉多孕育了马托皮巴计划，这是国家主导支持边疆扩张和农业金融化的最新例子之一。基于2016-2017年的实地调查，本文讨论了马托皮巴（占塞拉多面积三分之一的次区域）的土地攫取和金融化进程。本文分析的过程既具有全球性，又不可避免地植根于巴西的社会政治背景，这一背景由最近三届国家政府以及2022年当选、2023年就职的现任政府所提供的前景所界定。考虑到资本在巴西农业综合企业中的长期存在，本研究分析了外国个人如何成功利用对当地土地动态的了解，并将自己定位为机构投资者的中介。结果，这些行为者实际上促进并推动了该地区的金融化进程。这种向金融化的转变是在当前的政治和经济背景下考虑的，这一背景有可能进一步加速外国和跨国资本进入巴西农村，加剧塞拉多围绕土地和领土权利的现有冲突。

articles.title_en: Smallholder value creation in agrifood chains: Value network approach
articles.title_cn: 农业食品链中的小农户价值创造：价值网络方法
articles.abstract_en: To much of the development community, improving the inclusiveness of agrifood chains demands private institutional innovations that attenuate market failures confronting smallholders. How and how well such innovations contribute to sustainable rural development is still poorly understood, however, with research to date insufficiently generalizable to inform policy and practice. This partly stems from excessive reliance on instrumental and lead firm-centric perspectives on value creation that fail to recognize the complex organizational networks required to include, empower, and upgrade smallholders. To improve the explanatory capacity of existing theories and approaches, this article reconceptualizes how smallholders and other chain and non-chain actors derive value from participating in agrifood chains. Our ‘value networks’ inspired approach helps scholars and evaluators investigate and causally attribute how different types of value are created and captured through different types of private institutional innovations. We furthermore demonstrate how the approach can be used to generate the knowledge needed to advance business practice, development policy, and global value chain, global production network, and household theories.
articles.abstract_cn: 对于许多发展界人士而言，提高农业食品链的包容性需要私人制度创新，以减轻小农户面临的市场失灵。然而，这些创新如何以及多大程度上促进可持续农村发展仍知之甚少，迄今为止的研究不足以推广以指导政策和实践。这部分源于对价值创造的过度依赖工具性和领先企业中心视角，未能认识到包容、赋权和提升小农户所需的复杂组织网络。为了提高现有理论和方法的解释能力，本文重新概念化了小农户及其他链内和链外行动者如何从参与农业食品链中获取价值。我们受‘价值网络’启发的方法有助于学者和评估者调查并因果归因不同类型价值如何通过不同类型的私人制度创新被创造和捕获。此外，我们展示了如何使用该方法来生成推进商业实践、发展政策以及全球价值链、全球生产网络和家庭理论所需的知识。

articles.title_en: Pockets of persistence of agricultural land use during the socioeconomic shock of forced post-WWII displacements in the Carpathians
articles.title_cn: 二战后喀尔巴阡山脉强迫流离失所的社会经济冲击期间农业用地利用的持续小块区域
articles.abstract_en: Socioeconomic shocks can cause regime shifts in land use, but even during shocks, and when land use change is widespread, some areas persist in their land use. The question is what makes these areas more resistant. Our research goal was to find out what explains where arable farming persisted despite a major socioeconomic shock of forced post-war displacements. Our study area were 291 villages in the Polish Carpathians where abandonment due to the forced displacement of the Ukrainian population after WWII was widespread. We compared pre-war arable land with 1990 CORINE Land Cover data to quantify land-use change throughout the socialist period. We applied logistic regression with economically relevant environmental and access-related variables, and assessed the explanatory power of our models and relative importance of determinants. Forty years after forced displacements, arable farming persisted only in a small portion of what had been farmed in the 1940s (16 %), while the majority of former arable land converted to forests (54 %) or grasslands (22 %). Arable farming persisted mainly in areas with high accessibility that had oak-hornbeam forest as potential natural vegetation, on less steep slopes, and at lower elevations. Our models predicting agricultural abandonment leading to reforestation performed well (R2 = 0.57), but our model of persistent agriculture had low explanatory power (R2 = 0.26) as did models of conversion to grassland (R2 = 0.24). We therefore conclude that agricultural persistence is driven by different factors than agricultural land abandonment. In the long term, after arable farming ceases, areas can either be completely abandoned or convert to less intensive grassland use. These long-term changes have strong effects on biodiversity and ecosystem services, but are not well predicted by environmental and access-related determinants. Our findings can help to develop strategies and policies for areas affected by agricultural land abandonment caused by depopulation, and other socioeconomic shocks, and highlight the need to understand not only why arable land is abandoned, but also what determines its long-term fate.
articles.abstract_cn: 社会经济冲击可能导致土地利用的体制转变，但即使在冲击期间，且土地利用变化广泛存在时，一些区域仍保持其土地利用。问题在于是什么使这些区域更具抵抗力。我们的研究目标是找出在战后强迫流离失所的重大社会经济冲击下，哪些因素解释了耕地农业的持续存在。我们的研究区域是波兰喀尔巴阡山脉的291个村庄，二战后乌克兰人口被迫流离失所导致的弃耕现象普遍存在。我们将战前耕地与1990年CORINE土地覆盖数据进行比较，以量化整个社会主义时期的土地利用变化。我们应用了逻辑回归，包含经济相关的环境和可达性变量，并评估了我们模型的解释力及决定因素的相对重要性。强迫流离失所四十年后，耕地农业仅在1940年耕种面积的一小部分（16%）中持续存在，而大部分前耕地转变为森林（54%）或草地（22%）。耕地农业主要持续存在于可达性高、潜在自然植被为橡树-鹅耳枥森林、坡度较缓、海拔较低的区域。我们预测导致重新造林的农业弃耕模型表现良好（R2 = 0.57），但我们的持续农业模型解释力较低（R2 = 0.26），转为草地的模型也是如此（R2 = 0.24）。因此，我们得出结论，农业持续性与农业弃耕受不同因素驱动。长期来看，在耕地农业停止后，区域可能完全弃耕或转为较不密集的草地利用。这些长期变化对生物多样性和生态系统服务有强烈影响，但环境和可达性相关决定因素并不能很好地预测。我们的发现有助于为受人口减少和其他社会经济冲击导致的农业弃耕影响的区域制定战略和政策，并强调不仅需要理解耕地为何被弃耕，还需要理解什么决定了其长期命运。

articles.title_en: Urban air pollution anxieties, forest conservation, and farmland expropriation: State territorialization in the uplands and highlands of northern Thailand
articles.title_cn: 城市空气污染焦虑、森林保护与农田征用：泰国北部高地与山地的国家领土化
articles.abstract_en: The burning of agricultural residue during the dry season in rural northern Thailand has been identified as an important source of air pollution at the heart of an ongoing haze crisis particularly felt in the region’s urban areas. Public outcry in Chiang Mai over poor air quality pressured the government into developing fire management and prevention efforts in areas with high numbers of open-air fires, such as Mae Chaem district. Nevertheless, the haze situation deteriorated, prompting the 2014–2019 military-led government to develop a pilot fire-reduction project known as the Mae Chaem Model, whose original design to mitigate and prevent fires in the district evolved into a series of sustainable development objectives. Given optimistic discourses surrounding the project’s novel and participatory nature, this paper offers a critical analysis of initial project results. The project claims to offer prized benefits such as tenure security in exchange for the collaboration of villagers in the project. Interviews with villagers and other stakeholders reveal a series of concerns regarding 1) the production of land use history maps for 2002, 2011 and 2016, and 2) substantial expropriation of farmland and other severe land use restrictions. Our calculations suggest that, under a likely scenario, an average of 66% of farmland would be expropriated in the process (88% in one community). In accordance with villagers interviewed in two villages of Mae Chaem district, we are concerned about the capacity of local villagers to sufficiently intensify their production or otherwise limit the negative impact of such drastic land use restrictions on their livelihood. The paper also outlines other problems related to the temporary and revocable nature of the benefits offered and the rather dubious claims of coercion-free ‘participation’.
articles.abstract_cn: 泰国北部农村旱季焚烧农业残留物已被确定为持续雾霾危机的重要空气污染源，该危机在该地区城市地区尤为明显。清迈公众对空气质量差的抗议迫使政府在高露天火灾数量的地区（如湄占县）制定火灾管理和预防措施。然而，雾霾状况恶化，促使2014-2019年军政府制定了一个名为“湄占模式”的试点减火项目，其最初设计旨在缓解和预防该县火灾，后来演变为一系列可持续发展目标。鉴于围绕该项目新颖和参与性特点的乐观论述，本文对项目初步结果进行了批判性分析。该项目声称提供诸如土地使用权保障等宝贵利益，以换取村民在项目中的合作。对村民和其他利益相关者的访谈揭示了一系列担忧，包括1）为2002年、2011年和2016年制作土地利用历史地图，以及2）大量农田征用和其他严格土地使用限制。我们的计算表明，在可能的情况下，平均66%的农田将在过程中被征用（一个社区为88%）。根据对湄占县两个村庄村民的访谈，我们担心当地村民是否有能力充分集约化生产或以其他方式限制这种剧烈土地使用限制对其生计的负面影响。本文还概述了与所提供利益的临时性和可撤销性以及关于无胁迫“参与”的可疑主张相关的其他问题。

articles.title_en: Measuring the effects of public land use change: An analysis of greenways in Raleigh, North Carolina
articles.title_cn: 公共土地利用变化的效应测量：北卡罗来纳州罗利市绿道分析
articles.abstract_en: From 2010–2015 Wake County, NC, and the City of Raleigh, have experienced prolific growth of outdoor amenities, primarily financed through the passage of parks and open space bond referenda. Wake County currently has over 100 miles of off-street, paved greenway trails connecting schools, parks museums and commercial areas, 65 miles of which have been added from 2010 to 2015. As a result of the expansion of the Capital Area Greenway System, several neighborhoods in Wake County now have access to new recreation and transportation opportunities. This research estimates the effects of expanding greenway infrastructure and evaluates heterogeneous demand for greenway infrastructure across households. Using a hedonic framework, I estimate the capitalization effect of greenway expansion, I find heterogeneity in capitalized values ranging from − 4–12% dependent on spatial location and highlight potential drivers of heterogeneous values.
articles.abstract_cn: 从2010-2015年，北卡罗来纳州韦克县和罗利市经历了户外设施的快速增长，主要通过公园和开放空间债券公投的通过来融资。韦克县目前拥有超过100英里的路边铺砌绿道，连接学校、公园、博物馆和商业区，其中65英里是在2010至2015年间新增的。由于首都地区绿道系统的扩展，韦克县的几个社区现在可以享受到新的娱乐和交通机会。本研究估计了绿道基础设施扩展的效应，并评估了不同家庭对绿道基础设施的异质性需求。使用特征价格框架，我估计了绿道扩展的资本化效应，发现资本化价值存在异质性，范围从4-12%不等，取决于空间位置，并强调了异质性价值的潜在驱动因素。

articles.title_en: Productivity dynamics and state support after a land titling program: Evidence from Colombia
articles.title_cn: 土地确权项目后的生产率动态与国家支持：来自哥伦比亚的证据
articles.abstract_en: Despite having allocated and titled 23 million hectares of land over three land reforms, Colombia’s current titling program is viewed as a failure and a driver of land inequality. One potential reason for this outcome is the inability of beneficiaries of a title deed—or, in specific cases, a new formal plot—to establish long-term productive projects, leading many to sell. This study estimates the productivity path of beneficiaries after receiving a land title and considers heterogeneities induced by their access to complementary policies. This study uses Generalized Propensity Scores and exploits the randomness of the time between the title’s issuance and the realization of a national representative survey on beneficiary households. On average, productivity decreases by almost 50 % 2.5 years after program’s implementation. However, it recovers by the beginning of the fifth year. This paper also finds not only that farmers exhibit higher productivity levels when they receive access to credit or technical assistance, but that such support also mitigates and delays the observed drop in productivity after title allocation. Considering the imminent formalization of ten million hectares of public land, these findings call on the Colombian government to revise this titling program and execute the complementary policies already foreseen in this reform.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管在三次土地改革中分配并确权了23万公顷土地，哥伦比亚当前的确权项目仍被视为失败，并被认为是土地不平等的驱动因素。这一结果的一个潜在原因是，地契受益人——或在特定情况下，新的正式地块——无法建立长期生产性项目，导致许多人出售土地。本研究估计了受益人获得土地所有权后的生产率路径，并考虑了因获得补充政策而产生的异质性。本研究使用广义倾向得分，并利用所有权颁发与全国代表性受益人家庭调查实施之间的时间随机性。平均而言，在项目实施后50%年，生产率下降近2.5。然而，到第五年年初，生产率得以恢复。本文还发现，农民在获得信贷或技术援助时不仅表现出更高的生产率水平，而且这种支持还减轻并延迟了所有权分配后观察到的生产率下降。考虑到即将正式化一千万公顷公共土地，这些发现呼吁哥伦比亚政府修订这一确权项目，并执行该改革中已预见的补充政策。

articles.title_en: Adapted institutional analysis and development framework for understanding customary land institutions in sub-Saharan Africa – A case study from Nigeria
articles.title_cn: 适应制度分析与发展框架以理解撒哈拉以南非洲的习惯土地制度——来自尼日利亚的案例研究
articles.abstract_en: Customary land institutions (CLIs) are social institutions that define local land governance in communities. Strengthening community rights continues to be an essential land policy goal, and several studies have focused on ways to improve local land governance through CLIs. Relatively limited attention, however, has been paid to understanding these institutions in themselves. The present study addresses this gap and develops an analytical framework built on the well-known institutional analysis and development framework to support the understanding of CLIs in the context of sub-Saharan Africa (SSA). The framework was developed through a hermeneutic review of literature on CLIs in SSA. Accordingly, we mapped and classified the literature based on the concepts in the institutional analysis and development framework. The developed framework facilitates a detailed analysis of the contextual factors and customary land practices of CLIs, enabling a determination of their adequate and inadequate aspects. The framework was applied to understand the CLI in Ile-Ife through content analysis of primary and secondary data on the CLI. The case study application suggests that the framework can enable the understanding of CLI and the identification of the potentials and weaknesses within the institution. Notwithstanding, further exploration of the proposed framework should be carried out in other SSA contexts to validate its functionality.
articles.abstract_cn: 习惯土地制度（CLIs）是界定社区地方土地治理的社会制度。加强社区权利仍然是重要的土地政策目标，多项研究聚焦于通过CLIs改善地方土地治理的途径。然而，对这些制度本身的理解关注相对有限。本研究填补了这一空白，并基于著名的制度分析与发展框架构建了一个分析框架，以支持在撒哈拉以南非洲（SSA）背景下理解CLIs。该框架通过对SSA中CLIs文献的解释性回顾而开发。据此，我们根据制度分析与发展框架中的概念对文献进行了映射和分类。所开发的框架有助于详细分析CLIs的背景因素和习惯土地实践，从而确定其充分与不充分的方面。该框架被应用于通过内容分析关于CLI的一手和二手数据来理解伊莱-伊费的CLI。案例研究应用表明，该框架能够促进对CLI的理解以及识别制度内的潜力和弱点。尽管如此，应在其他SSA背景下进一步探索所提出的框架以验证其功能。

articles.title_en: Linking food and land system research in Europe
articles.title_cn: 连接欧洲粮食与土地系统研究
articles.abstract_en: Food-system studies often assess dynamics in production, consumption or processing and logistics in a spatially abstract manner. Land-system studies traditionally analyze land-use/land cover change with its environmental and societal drivers as well as impacts and are typically spatially explicit. Primary production is a main node where food and land systems overlap. We used a systematic literature review to determine how existing studies in Europe address the interface of food and land systems. We identified three pathways of studies: economic, footprint and crop modeling studies (pathway 1), and scenario-based land-use/land-cover change and remote sensing studies (pathway 2), and (qualitative) policy studies (pathway 3). The reviewed studies only partially integrate land- and food-system research. Most of these studies are stronger on the land- than on the food-system side and miss processing as well as distribution and sales. In addition, major linkages between land and food systems are implemented deterministically in the reviewed studies (e.g., through static land requirements for diets). Here, the role of actors and dynamic models considering systemic feedbacks could improve the realisms of studies. Therefore, this study develops a framework to reveal the interplay between food- and land-system research. It focusses on urban-rural linkages as both research strands analyze major processes at this interface: the rural-urban exchange of food and urban sprawl. Future research should especially address and quantify governance, which is hardly quantified to date. Urban-rural linkages are weakly considered in the reviewed literature and if considered only from an urban perspective. Thereby, it would be interesting to study to which extent rural population and governance shape urban-rural-linkages, and how a change of focus from rural to urban areas could provide additional insights.
articles.abstract_cn: 粮食系统研究通常以空间抽象的方式评估生产、消费或加工及物流的动态。土地系统研究传统上分析土地利用/土地覆盖变化及其环境和社会驱动因素及影响，并且通常具有空间明确性。初级生产是粮食和土地系统重叠的主要节点。我们使用系统性文献综述来确定欧洲现有研究如何处理粮食与土地系统的界面。我们识别出三条研究路径：经济、足迹和作物建模研究（路径1），基于情景的土地利用/土地覆盖变化和遥感研究（路径2），以及（定性）政策研究（路径3）。所审查的研究仅部分整合了土地和粮食系统研究。这些研究大多在土地方面强于粮食系统方面，并且缺少加工以及分销和销售环节。此外，在所审查的研究中，土地和粮食系统之间的主要联系是确定性实施的（例如，通过静态的饮食土地需求）。在这里，行动者的作用和考虑系统性反馈的动态模型可以提高研究的现实性。因此，本研究开发了一个框架来揭示粮食与土地系统研究之间的相互作用。它关注城乡联系，因为这两条研究线索都分析了这一界面的主要过程：农村与城市之间的粮食交换和城市扩张。未来的研究应特别关注并量化治理，而迄今为止治理几乎未被量化。在所审查的文献中，城乡联系被考虑得很少，如果被考虑，也仅从城市视角出发。因此，研究农村人口和治理在多大程度上塑造城乡联系，以及将焦点从农村地区转向城市地区如何能提供额外见解，将是很有趣的。

articles.title_en: Integrating ecosystem services in transfer of development rights: a literature review
articles.title_cn: 将生态系统服务纳入开发权转让：文献综述
articles.abstract_en: In recent years, transfer of development rights (TDR) programs have become widespread as a mechanism for implementing urban transformations and achieving planning goals. As market-based instruments, they facilitate land acquisition whilst avoiding compulsory purchases and minimizing public spending. By promoting urban transformation, TDR programs affect the provision of ecosystem services (ES) delivered by green and permeable areas. ES are essential for wellbeing, and the inclusion of ES in planning decisions promotes sustainable urban development. This research aims to provide a starting point for mainstreaming ES knowledge in TDR studies and application. Through a literature review, this paper aims to gain greater understanding as to what ways, and to what extent, ES have been considered so far in TDR studies and to identify if there is evidence that demonstrates how ES can be included in the design phases of TDR programs to improve their effectiveness in ensuring sustainable spatial transformations. The results show that the inclusion of ES can strengthen the ex-ante phase of TDR processes, supporting the development of the design features and paying greater attention to receiving areas identified during the process.
articles.abstract_cn: 近年来，开发权转让（TDR）项目作为实施城市转型和实现规划目标的机制已广泛普及。作为基于市场的工具，它们促进了土地获取，同时避免了强制购买并最小化公共支出。通过促进城市转型，TDR项目影响了绿色和透水区域提供的生态系统服务（ES）的供给。ES对福祉至关重要，将ES纳入规划决策有助于促进可持续城市发展。本研究旨在为将ES知识纳入TDR研究和应用提供起点。通过文献综述，本文旨在更深入地理解迄今为止ES在TDR研究中被考虑的方式和程度，并确定是否有证据表明ES如何被纳入TDR项目的设计阶段，以提高其在确保可持续空间转型方面的有效性。结果表明，纳入ES可以加强TDR过程的实施前阶段，支持设计特征的发展，并更加关注过程中确定的接收区域。

articles.title_en: Investigating local policy instruments for different types of urban agriculture in four European cities: A case study analysis on the use and effectiveness of the applied policy instruments
articles.title_cn: 调查欧洲四城市不同类型城市农业的地方政策工具：关于所应用政策工具的使用与有效性的案例研究分析
articles.abstract_en: Over the last decades, urban agriculture (UA) and controlled environmental agriculture (CEA) have been growing in many urban areas of the world to supply fresh food locally and to provide multiple benefits for the sustainable development of urban landscapes. Municipal policies and regulatory tools are increasingly employed to support UA/CEA and minimize practical challenges. However, especially in Europe, there is a lack of systematic reviews that evaluate the impacts of city-level food policies for UA/CEA and their effectiveness as perceived by local responsible actors. To address this gap, this study presents a qualitative overview of municipal policies that affect UA/CEA. We reviewed more than 83 policy documents and manuscripts and performed an online structured survey targeting key local managers or employees of UA and innovative CEA systems in four EU cities – Barcelona (Spain), Lyon (France), Trieste and Udine (Italy). We assessed policy tools, especially for three identified types of UA (allotment gardens, community gardens and closed spaces using CEA) by mainly focusing on public and private institutions and including aspects concerning land use planning, health and environmental policies. The findings demonstrate how the four cities’ municipal governments specifically designed and combined a multiplicity of policy instruments to enable, regulate and acknowledge UA/CEA as part of the urban metabolism and landscape. The policy instruments were shaped by different local governance and institutional structures as well as by the local actors and community practitioners and their growing interest in UA/CEA.
articles.abstract_cn: 在过去几十年中，城市农业（UA）和受控环境农业（CEA）在世界许多城市地区不断增长，以在当地供应新鲜食品，并为城市景观的可持续发展提供多重效益。市政政策和监管工具越来越多地被用于支持UA/CEA并尽量减少实际挑战。然而，特别是在欧洲，缺乏系统性的评估，以评价城市层面食品政策对UA/CEA的影响及其被当地责任主体所感知的有效性。为弥补这一空白，本研究对影响UA/CEA的市政政策进行了定性概述。我们回顾了超过83份政策文件和手稿，并在四个欧盟城市——巴塞罗那（西班牙）、里昂（法国）、的里雅斯特和乌迪内（意大利）——进行了一项针对当地UA和创新CEA系统关键管理人员或员工的在线结构化调查。我们评估了政策工具，特别是针对三种已识别的UA类型（分配花园、社区花园和使用CEA的封闭空间），主要关注公共和私人机构，并包括涉及土地利用规划、健康和环境政策的方面。研究结果表明，这四个城市的市政府如何具体设计和组合多种政策工具，以启用、规范和承认UA/CEA作为城市代谢和景观的一部分。这些政策工具受到不同的地方治理和制度结构以及当地行动者和社区从业者及其对UA/CEA日益增长的兴趣的影响。

articles.title_en: Linking social-ecological management and ecosystem service bundles: Lessons from a peri-urban agriculture landscape
articles.title_cn: 连接社会-生态管理与生态系统服务簇：来自城郊农业景观的启示
articles.abstract_en: Peri-urban ecosystems especially peri-urban agriculture play an important part in multiple dimensions of both rural and urban sustainability and resilience. Yet such ecosystems on which diverse services depend are not given the commensurate concerns like city themes, and thus the lack of understanding about the interdependence characteristic within ES variation and the driving mechanism of socio-environmental factors limits effective ecological policymaking and urban-rural planning. In this study, we provided a framework revealing the complicated relationship of ecosystem services in a peri-urban area in southern Shanghai, China which is dominated by agricultural landscapes. Our findings stem from a combination of mapping quantification, statistical approaches and GIS-based techniques. The results showed that the provisioning services show trade-offs to some extent with regulating and cultural services. Six distinct ecosystem service bundles are identified and they are shaped by numerous site-specific characteristics which foster the orientation of ecosystem service management toward multifunctionality. We concluded that the spatially explicit information with GIS-based trade-off analysis is an efficient way to uncover the complicated relationships among various ecosystem services. The optimization of land cover forms and landscape characteristics is required for the sustainable management of agricultural landscapes. Ecosystem service bundles incorporating landscape features and differentiated perceptions of local residents provide rich evidence for the formulation of sustainable cultural land management strategies. They should be regarded as an indispensable element in developing both city and rural planning and multifunctional management.
articles.abstract_cn: 城郊生态系统，尤其是城郊农业，在农村和城市的可持续性与韧性多个维度中扮演重要角色。然而，这些支撑多样化服务的生态系统并未像城市主题那样受到同等关注，因此对生态系统服务变化内部相互依赖特征及社会环境因素驱动机制的理解不足，限制了有效的生态政策制定和城乡规划。在本研究中，我们提供了一个框架，揭示了中国上海南部以农业景观为主的城郊地区生态系统服务的复杂关系。我们的研究结果源于制图量化、统计方法和基于GIS技术的结合。结果表明，供给服务在一定程度上与调节和文化服务存在权衡关系。识别出六个不同的生态系统服务簇，它们由众多特定地点的特征塑造，这些特征促进了生态系统服务管理向多功能性方向发展。我们得出结论，基于GIS的权衡分析的空间显式信息是揭示多种生态系统服务之间复杂关系的有效途径。土地覆盖形式和景观特征的优化对于农业景观的可持续管理是必要的。结合景观特征和当地居民差异化感知的生态系统服务簇，为制定可持续的文化土地管理策略提供了丰富证据。它们应被视为制定城市和农村规划及多功能管理中不可或缺的要素。

articles.title_en: Negotiated windfalls: Mapping how public actors pursue and share land-value capture in Nanterre-la-Folie, France
articles.title_cn: 谈判中的意外之财：描绘法国南泰尔-拉福利公共行为者如何追求和分享土地增值捕获
articles.abstract_en: This article seeks to broaden the scope of discussions pertaining to land-value capture (LVC). Scholars have now accumulated considerable documentation and analyses on how public authorities can (and whether they should) capture land-value increases that stem from actions other than the landowner’s. Little attention has been paid, however, to how public actors might compete for, and share the fruit of LVC. Using the case study of Nanterre-la-Folie, a district located in the vicinity of a new train station within the Grand Paris metropolitan area, we draw attention to the interplay of a variety of public actors (transit operators, local governments, national government) as they negotiate their share of transit-related LVC. In doing so, we show that the largely agreed-upon narrative of LVC as public actors versus private ones leaves important aspects of planning in a blind spot. By drawing attention to public actors’ competition for transit-related LVC, we inform academic debates on metropolitan governance and highlight implications for the unfolding and outcomes of real-estate projects.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文旨在拓宽有关土地增值捕获（LVC）的讨论范围。学者们现已积累了大量的文献和分析，探讨公共当局如何（以及是否应当）捕获并非源于土地所有者行为的土地增值。然而，对于公共行为者如何竞争并分享LVC的成果，却鲜有关注。通过以南泰尔-拉福利（Nanterre-la-Folie）这一位于大巴黎都市区内新火车站附近地区的案例研究，我们关注到多种公共行为者（交通运营商、地方政府、国家政府）在谈判其与交通相关的LVC份额时的相互作用。通过这样做，我们表明，将LVC大致描述为公共行为者与私人行为者之间的对立，使得规划的重要方面处于盲区。通过关注公共行为者对交通相关LVC的竞争，我们为关于大都市治理的学术辩论提供了信息，并强调了其对房地产项目的发展和结果的影响。

articles.title_en: Dynamics of negotiated use of public open spaces between children and adults in an African city
articles.title_cn: 非洲城市中儿童与成人之间公共开放空间协商使用的动态
articles.abstract_en: The sustainable development goal (SDG) 11 emphasizes the role of public open space (POS) in creating inclusive and liveable cities. The present study coupled concepts of right to the city, inclusion, and negotiation to illustrate how inner-city children and adults establish a harmonized consumption of a district POS. The study examines how different age groups can achieve a consensus-based consumption of a vulnerable, small, and intensively used POS in Kano City, Nigeria. Data were collected using 358 self-administered questionnaires and field observation and analyzed using thematic content analysis, a multifunctional matrix, and analysis of variance (ANOVA) to illustrate the negotiated uses of the POS. The study found that children and adults in this densely populated city depend on the POS covering only 0.5 ha for recreational, religious, and informal commercial activities. Users reach a consensus regarding sharing and separation of uses in a zero-conflict and lively atmosphere, underscoring the multifunctionality of this small POS. This study contributes to our understanding of the values of POS as a platform for fostering social coexistence, multiculturalism, tolerance, sharing, and collaborative consumption of scarce resources in cities. The study can assist municipalities in developing inclusive strategies for implementing SDG 11 to create more sustainable cities and communities.
articles.abstract_cn: 可持续发展目标（SDG）11强调了公共开放空间（POS）在创建包容性和宜居城市中的作用。本研究结合了城市权、包容性和协商的概念，以说明内城儿童和成人如何建立对区域POS的和谐消费。研究考察了尼日利亚卡诺市不同年龄群体如何实现对脆弱、小型且密集使用的POS的基于共识的消费。数据通过358份自填问卷和实地观察收集，并使用主题内容分析、多功能矩阵和方差分析（ANOVA）进行分析，以说明POS的协商使用。研究发现，在这个人口密集的城市中，儿童和成人依赖仅覆盖0.5公顷的POS进行娱乐、宗教和非正式商业活动。用户在零冲突和活跃的氛围中就共享和分离使用达成共识，突显了这个小POS的多功能性。本研究有助于我们理解POS作为促进社会共存、多元文化、宽容、共享和城市稀缺资源协作消费平台的价值。该研究可协助市政当局制定包容性战略，以实施SDG 11，创建更可持续的城市和社区。

articles.title_en: The prospects of innovative agri-environmental contracts in the European policy context: Results from a Delphi study
articles.title_cn: 欧洲政策背景下创新农业环境合同的前景：德尔菲研究的结果
articles.abstract_en: Innovative agri-environmental contracts are increasingly studied in the literature, but their adoption has been relatively slow and geographically scattered. Action-based agri-environmental measures remain the predominant policy mechanism across Europe. A three-round Policy Delphi study was conducted with policy makers, scientific experts, farmers’ representatives, and NGOs from across 15 different European countries, to investigate how and under which circumstances novel contractual solutions could be implemented more widely. The expert panel perceived result-based and collective contractual elements as the most promising. Although considered beneficial from several aspects, value chain contracts were perceived less relevant to the policy environment. The Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) Pillar 2 measures were highlighted by the experts as the key policy area to implement novel contracts by national or regional authorities, but Pillar 1 eco-schemes, being launched in the CAP 2023–2027, were also considered as a potentially suitable framework for testing and implementation. The Delphi panel envisaged innovative contracts should be adopted by governments in iterative steps and not as a complete substitute for current payment schemes, but rather as an additional incentive to them. Such an incremental approach allows contractual innovations to capitalise on existing best practices. But it also implies the risk that innovative contracts could remain marginal and fail to substantially change farmers’ behaviour, resulting in a failure to improve environmental conditions.
articles.abstract_cn: 文献中对创新农业环境合同的研究越来越多，但其采用相对缓慢且地理分散。基于行动的农业环境措施仍然是整个欧洲的主要政策机制。来自15不同欧洲国家的政策制定者、科学专家、农民代表和非政府组织进行了一项三轮政策德尔菲研究，以调查如何以及在什么情况下可以更广泛地实施新颖的合同解决方案。专家小组认为基于结果的集体合同要素是最有希望的。尽管价值链合同被认为在多个方面都是有益的，但人们认为价值链合同与政策环境的相关性较小。专家们强调，共同农业政策 (CAP) 支柱 2 措施是国家或地区当局实施新合同的关键政策领域，但 CAP 2023-2027 中启动的支柱 1 生态计划也被认为是一个可能适合测试和实施的框架。德尔福小组设想，政府应逐步采用创新合同，而不是作为当前支付计划的完全替代品，而是作为对他们的额外激励。这种渐进的方法允许合同创新利用现有的最佳实践。但这也意味着创新合同可能仍然处于边缘地位，无法实质性改变农民的行为，从而导致无法改善环境条件的风险。

articles.title_en: Sustainability strategies and stakeholder management for upland farming
articles.title_cn: 高地农业的可持续性战略与利益相关者管理
articles.abstract_en: Upland farming provides important benefits to society. To retain these benefits, measures to encourage farms to adopt practices that balance economic, environmental and social aspects of sustainability are required. This study used survey data from a sample of farms located in less-favoured areas in Northern England to identify the trade-offs between the three dimensions of farm-level sustainability and the impacts of farm behaviours on them, including diversification, participation in agri-environmental policies and stakeholder management. Results showed that farm businesses may face a trade-off between improving economic and environmental performance through their decisions about participating in agri-environmental schemes and that strengthening relationships with some stakeholders is critical for achieving sustainability. This suggests that future policy design may simultaneously improve three dimensions of sustainability by promoting environmental conservation activities through non-economic incentives and by encouraging farm businesses to build good working relationships with their stakeholders.
articles.abstract_cn: 高地农业为社会提供了重要的益处。为了保留这些益处，需要采取措施鼓励农场采用平衡经济、环境和社会可持续性方面的做法。本研究利用位于英格兰北部欠发达地区的农场样本调查数据，识别了农场层面可持续性三个维度之间的权衡，以及农场行为（包括多样化、参与农业环境政策和利益相关者管理）对它们的影响。结果表明，农场企业可能面临通过参与农业环境计划决策来提高经济和环境绩效之间的权衡，并且加强与某些利益相关者的关系对于实现可持续性至关重要。这表明，未来的政策设计可以通过非经济激励促进环境保护活动，并鼓励农场企业与利益相关者建立良好的工作关系，从而同时改善可持续性的三个维度。

articles.title_en: To what extent are ecosystem services provided by geodiversity affected by anthropogenic impacts? A quantitative study in Caraguatatuba, Southeast coast of Brazil
authors: Lígia Maria de Almeida Leite Ribeiro
articles.abstract_en: Ecosystem services (ES) provided by geodiversity are goods that directly and indirectly benefit society and can be classified into regulating, supporting, provisioning, cultural, and knowledge functions. The integrated assessment of geodiversity with an emphasis on ES is relevant for conservation and territorial management strategies. The current work aims the identification and assessment of impacts on ES provided by geodiversity in the Caraguatatuba county, with an emphasis in the Serra do Mar State Park (SMSP), on the Southeast coast of Brazil. The methodological procedures followed two steps: (i) identification of the ES based on the recognition of the Essential Geodiversity Variables (EGVs) and bibliographic research and (ii) quantitative assessment of the impacts on the ES provided by geodiversity based on land use categories. Seventy-five ES provided by geodiversity were identified in Caraguatatuba, being the ecosystem functions affected by urban area and native vegetation land use categories, respectively: supporting (50.9%), regulating (47.7%), cultural (41.9%), knowledge (34.9%), and provisioning (31.2%). The results indicate that the supporting and regulating functions, such as aquifers, fauna and flora habitats, and carbon sequestration and storage, are the ones that require the most effective environmental impact mitigation measures. This approach can contribute not only to academic works, but to different economic sectors to achieve sustainable development.

articles.title_en: A new type of urbanization policy and transition of low-carbon society: A "local- neighborhood" perspective
articles.title_cn: 新型城镇化政策与低碳社会转型：一个“本地-邻里”视角
articles.abstract_en: This study aims to develop a framework linking New-Type Urbanization (NTU) and carbon emissions, considering both direct and spillover effects. Firstly, the paper constructs a multi-dimensional index to measure NTU and documents the spatial patterns of NTU levels in China, showing remarkable inequality between the eastern and western regions. Secondly, the study evaluates the effectiveness of pilot policies aimed at achieving Smart City and NTU goals. Using the Difference-in-Difference model based on panel data collected from 108 cities in the Yangtze River Economic Belt from 2006 to 2019, the study provides empirical evidence that these policies can significantly reduce carbon emissions in terms of production and consumption. Moreover, the study finds that the policies have significant spatial spillover effects on neighboring cities based on the Spatial Panel Durbin Model. The findings suggest that such policies can effectively reduce carbon emissions in areas with significant human activity and have important policy implications for achieving sustainable development in China.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究旨在构建一个将新型城镇化（NTU）与碳排放联系起来并同时考虑直接效应和溢出效应的框架。首先，本文构建了一个多维指数来衡量新型城镇化，并记录了中国新型城镇化水平的空间格局，显示出东部和西部地区之间的显著不平等。其次，本研究评估了旨在实现智慧城市和新型城镇化目标的试点政策的有效性。基于2006年至2019年长江经济带108个城市的面板数据，采用双重差分模型，研究提供了这些政策能够显著减少生产和消费方面碳排放的经验证据。此外，基于空间面板杜宾模型，研究发现这些政策对邻近城市具有显著的空间溢出效应。研究结果表明，此类政策可以有效减少人类活动显著区域的碳排放，并对中国实现可持续发展具有重要的政策启示。

articles.title_en: Protecting land and livelihood under climate risks: What hinders crop insurance adoption?
articles.title_cn: 气候风险下的土地与生计保护：什么阻碍了作物保险的采纳？
articles.abstract_en: Small-scale agriculturists in developing countries face continuous weather-related risks, which are exacerbated by the growing issues of climate change (See Shah et al., 2018 for Pakistan; Zakaria et al. (2020) for Sub Sahara Africa). Despite efforts to introduce formal crop insurance at a subsidized rate by many governments, including in India, insurance penetration rates remain low in less developed countries (LDCs). One reason for this is continued reliance on informal credit as a risk-coping mechanism in poorer regions in times of agricultural distress. This prompts the question as to why farmers rely on these methods when apparently less expensive formal crop insurance is available. To answer, we investigate the link between the conditionalities of informal credit and the decision to adopt crop insurance together with other factors such as farmers’ socioeconomic class, education, and attitude to risk. Thereby, we derive policy implications for enhancing insurance penetration among poor farmers. A theoretical model is first constructed to provide a motivation for the empirical relation examined. An analysis of the decision to adopt crop insurance and the extent of insurance coverage availed is undertaken using a two-part fractional logistic regression with crop insurance data from India (provided by the National Sample Survey Office). The results demonstrate that informal interest rates are significantly and positively correlated with the probability of taking up crop insurance, and disparities between economic and social classes in the adoption of crop insurance exist. Although the ills of usurious informal interest rates are often highlighted (Bhaduri, 1997), this indirect positive effect on crop insurance penetration has not been established heretofore. The exercise also looks at the possibility of loss expected by a farmer and their insurance adoption behaviour by relating it to Prospect Theory (Kanheman, Tversky, 1979).
articles.abstract_cn: 发展中国家的农户持续面临与天气相关的风险，而气候变化问题日益严重加剧了这些风险（参见Shah等人，2018关于巴基斯坦的研究；Zakaria等人（2020）关于撒哈拉以南非洲的研究）。尽管包括印度在内的许多政府努力以补贴费率引入正式作物保险，但在欠发达国家（LDCs），保险渗透率仍然较低。原因之一是，在农业困境时期，较贫困地区持续依赖非正式信贷作为风险应对机制。这引发了一个问题：当显然更便宜的正式作物保险可用时，为什么农民依赖这些方法？为了回答这个问题，我们研究了非正式信贷的条件与采纳作物保险决策之间的联系，以及农民的社会经济阶层、教育程度和风险态度等其他因素。由此，我们得出了提高贫困农民保险渗透率的政策含义。首先构建了一个理论模型，为所检验的实证关系提供动机。使用来自印度（由国家抽样调查办公室提供）的作物保险数据，采用两部分分数逻辑回归对采纳作物保险的决策和所获得的保险覆盖程度进行了分析。结果表明，非正式利率与投保作物保险的概率显著正相关，并且经济和社会阶层在采纳作物保险方面存在差异。尽管高利贷非正式利率的弊端经常被强调（Bhaduri，1997），但这种对作物保险渗透率的间接积极影响此前尚未被确立。该研究还通过将农民预期损失的可能性与其保险采纳行为联系起来，参照前景理论（Kahneman，Tversky，1979）进行了探讨。

articles.title_en: A BIM-based approach to design a lifecycle 3D property formation process: A Swedish case study
articles.title_cn: 基于BIM的生命周期三维产权形成过程设计：瑞典案例研究
articles.abstract_en: 3D property formation has become an important solution to provide a more comprehensive and accurate representation of the property’s physical characteristics than traditional 2D property formation. Despite the numerous benefits of the 3D property formation, there is a need for more detailed descriptions of 3D cadastral data delivery between the involved actors to ensure efficient and effective collaboration. In particular, the practical difficulties are when/what related 3D cadastral information and models should be exchanged and stored from/to whom. Therefore, to address these issues, we propose a lifecycle 3D property formation process with four phases by designing an IDM process, which is an international open BIM process standard. In the purpose of forming a Swedish lifecycle 3D property formation process, the IDM process has been applied through organizational, legal and technical aspects, including identifying actors and their roles and values, gathering 3D property formation requirements, defining the data exchange requirements and designing the process map. Moreover, a case study was used to specify the Swedish lifecycle 3D property formation process and information delivery between stakeholders in the IDM. The aim is to facilitate a standardized and unambiguous digital 3D property formation procedure on a national level in order to improve and enhance the digital Swedish Cadastral and Land Administration Systems, but the process is quite generic and could also be applied in other countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 三维产权形成已成为比传统二维产权形成更全面、更准确地表示产权物理特征的重要解决方案。尽管三维产权形成具有诸多优势，但仍需对相关参与者之间的三维地籍数据交付进行更详细的描述，以确保高效、有效的协作。特别是，实际困难在于何时/何地交换和存储相关的三维地籍信息和模型，以及从谁/向谁交换和存储。因此，为解决这些问题，我们通过设计IDM过程（一种国际开放的BIM过程标准），提出了一个包含四个阶段的生命周期三维产权形成过程。为了形成瑞典的生命周期三维产权形成过程，IDM过程已通过组织、法律和技术方面得到应用，包括识别参与者及其角色和价值、收集三维产权形成需求、定义数据交换需求以及设计过程图。此外，还通过案例研究来具体说明瑞典的生命周期三维产权形成过程以及IDM中利益相关者之间的信息交付。其目的是在国家层面促进标准化、无歧义的数字三维产权形成程序，以改进和增强瑞典数字地籍和土地管理系统，但该过程相当通用，也可应用于其他国家。

articles.title_en: 3D crowdsourced parametric cadastral mapping: Pathways integrating BIM/IFC, crowdsourced data and LADM
articles.title_cn: 三维众包参数化地籍测绘：整合BIM/IFC、众包数据与LADM的路径
articles.abstract_en: This paper is part of a doctoral dissertation (PhD) research aligned with global trends aiming to develop practical technical tools for the collection, management and visualization of three-dimensional (3D) property rights in urban areas. Recently, the Building Information Models (BIMs) claim a prominent position in the field of 3D cadastres and the digital twins of the cities. In addition to all other building information, the BIM can also provide data about the exact boundaries of all kind of legal spaces (e.g., property ownership rights as well as land use restrictions), under the support of Industry Foundation Classes (IFCs). However, the utilization of BIMs for 3D cadastral surveys is still accompanied with two main drawbacks. The first refers to BIMs limited availability, as till now they mainly encounter in new large constructions. The second refers to the complexity in defining the exact geometric location of the legal boundaries regarding the exterior/interior partitions of the construction and of the common spaces. The latter parameter is formed on the basis of the current legal legislation in each country. Through in-depth investigation of the current legal framework of each country it may be possible to visualize the various 3D legal spaces within complex constructions and thus to facilitate the integration of existing BIMs in the development of 3D cadasters that will enable a better understanding and communication of all involved parties in the operation of cross-boundary real estate markets. In parallel, crowdsourcing has already been proved to be a powerful data collection method for the initial participatory implementation of fast, reliable and affordable 3D cadastral surveys, utilizing all capabilities provided by the latest low-cost devices, mobile services (m-services), open-source software (OSS) and the international standard of Land Administration Domain Model (LADM ISO 19152). If no precise 3D building models are already available, the currently available 2D architectural plans combined with the additional geometric and descriptive cadastral information may be utilized for a participatory crowdsourced cadastral survey of the 3D property units. In this paper a ‘two-route’ crowdsourced approach is described. This approach suggests both the use of existing BIMs – those available – to proceed with 3D crowdsourced cadastral surveys of those constructions, as well as the use of 2D georeferenced basemaps (e.g., orthophotos for the compilation of 2D crowdsourced cadastral surveys, and all existing architectural floor plans of the constructions) to proceed with 3D crowdsourced cadastral surveys of all other constructions. A database schema describing the linkage between LADM standard, BIM/IFC and 3D crowdsourced geometric and descriptive cadastral information is developed and presented. A hybrid mobile application enabling the manipulation of BIM/IFC descriptive data – if existing; the collection of 3D crowdsourced geometric and descriptive information by property owners/users/non-professionals; the registration of the cadastral data and their relationships within a LADM-based cadastral geodatabase; the automated generation of 3D property unit models as block models (LoD1), using Model-driven approach; and the objects visualization in real-time, are developed. An investigation regarding the legally correct representation of the location of property unit boundaries, focusing mainly in the Greek territory is conducted. A practical experiment for each one of the cases of the ‘two-route’ crowdsourced approach is implemented, for two multi-storey buildings in the city of Athens, Greece. The potentials of the proposed crowdsourced solution as well as the achieved geometric accuracy – in the absence of BIM – are discussed and assessed. The results show that integrating BIM data with cadastral information derived from crowdsourcing, may significantly contribute to the implementation of 3D Cadastres, providing also a better visual understanding of 3D property rights. Nonetheless, even in the absence of a BIM the achieved accuracy seems to satisfy the cadastral specifications of the Greek cadaster enhancing the potential of exploiting crowdsourced data in the initial phases of the cadastral formal procedures.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文是博士论文研究的一部分，与全球趋势一致，旨在开发实用的技术工具，用于城市地区三维（3D）产权数据的采集、管理和可视化。近年来，建筑信息模型（BIM）在三维地籍和城市数字孪生领域占据突出地位。除了所有其他建筑信息外，在工业基础类（IFC）的支持下，BIM还可以提供所有类型法律空间（例如，财产所有权以及土地使用限制）的精确边界数据。然而，将BIM用于三维地籍测量仍存在两个主要缺点。第一，BIM的可用性有限，因为目前它们主要出现在新建的大型建筑中。第二，在定义建筑外部/内部隔断和公共空间的法律边界的精确几何位置方面存在复杂性。后一个参数是根据每个国家当前的法律法规形成的。通过深入调查每个国家当前的法律框架，可能实现复杂建筑内各种三维法律空间的可视化，从而促进现有BIM在三维地籍开发中的整合，使跨界房地产市场的所有相关方能够更好地理解和沟通。与此同时，众包已被证明是一种强大的数据采集方法，用于初始参与式实施快速、可靠且负担得起的三维地籍测量，利用最新低成本设备、移动服务（m-services）、开源软件（OSS）以及土地管理领域模型（LADM ISO 19152）国际标准提供的所有能力。如果尚无可用的精确三维建筑模型，则可以利用当前可用的二维建筑平面图，结合额外的几何和描述性地籍信息，进行参与式众包三维产权单元地籍测量。本文描述了一种“双路径”众包方法。该方法建议既利用现有BIM（如果有的话）进行这些建筑的三维众包地籍测量，也利用二维地理参考底图（例如，用于编制二维众包地籍测量的正射影像，以及所有现有建筑楼层平面图）进行所有其他建筑的三维众包地籍测量。开发并提出了一个数据库模式，描述LADM标准、BIM/IFC和三维众包几何及描述性地籍信息之间的联系。开发了一个混合移动应用程序，能够处理BIM/IFC描述性数据（如果存在）；由业主/用户/非专业人员采集三维众包几何和描述性信息；在基于LADM的地籍地理数据库中注册地籍数据及其关系；使用模型驱动方法自动生成三维产权单元模型作为块模型（LoD1）；以及实时对象可视化。进行了一项关于产权单元边界位置合法正确表示的研究，主要聚焦于希腊领土。针对“双路径”众包方法中的每种情况，在希腊雅典市的两栋多层建筑中进行了实际实验。讨论了所提出的众包解决方案的潜力以及在没有BIM的情况下实现的几何精度，并进行了评估。结果表明，将BIM数据与来自众包的地籍信息相结合，可能显著促进三维地籍的实施，同时提供对三维产权的更好视觉理解。然而，即使在没有BIM的情况下，所达到的精度似乎也满足希腊地籍的地籍规范，增强了在正式地籍程序初始阶段利用众包数据的潜力。

articles.title_en: Proposing a multi-jurisdictional framework for 3D digital cadastre in Australia and New Zealand
articles.title_cn: 为澳大利亚和新西兰提出三维数字地籍的多司法管辖区框架
articles.abstract_en: Recent studies in Australia and New Zealand have explored various technological, legal, and institutional aspects of 3D cadastre modernisation. The majority of these studies concentrate on a single jurisdiction. The reason is that each jurisdiction is in charge of its own cadastral system. As a result, each jurisdiction's standards, rules, and processes for implementing 3D digital cadastre are unique. In Australia and New Zealand, however, the Intergovernmental Committee on Surveying and Mapping (ICSM) has established national frameworks for cadastral systems. To implement 3D digital cadastre at a national level, it is vital to identify the variations and commonalities across existing cadastral systems. Comparisons of 3D cadastre for several civil law countries as well as international standards have been undertaken in the present literature. However, common law jurisdictions such as Australian states and New Zealand have not been compared in terms of 3D cadastre. Therefore, the main goal of this study is to propose a multi-jurisdictional framework that includes variations and commonalities in the current methods adopted for subdividing ownership of vertically placed properties in order to support 3D digital cadastre in all Australian and New Zealand jurisdictions. The proposed framework comprises four layers: definition, core, interoperability and jurisdictional. This framework would potentially serve as a starting point for building a nationally integrated digital data ecosystem for 3D cadastre in Australia and New Zealand.
articles.abstract_cn: 澳大利亚和新西兰的近期研究探讨了三维地籍现代化的技术、法律和制度等多个方面。这些研究大多集中于单一司法管辖区，原因是每个司法管辖区负责自己的地籍系统。因此，每个司法管辖区实施三维数字地籍的标准、规则和流程都是独特的。然而，在澳大利亚和新西兰，测绘与制图政府间委员会（ICSM）已为地籍系统建立了国家框架。要在国家层面实施三维数字地籍，识别现有地籍系统之间的差异和共性至关重要。现有文献中已对多个大陆法系国家的三维地籍以及国际标准进行了比较。然而，普通法司法管辖区，如澳大利亚各州和新西兰，尚未在三维地籍方面进行比较。因此，本研究的主要目标是提出一个多司法管辖区框架，该框架包含当前用于细分垂直产权物业所有权的方法中的差异和共性，以支持澳大利亚和新西兰所有司法管辖区的三维数字地籍。拟议框架包括四个层次：定义层、核心层、互操作层和司法管辖区层。该框架可能作为在澳大利亚和新西兰构建国家一体化三维地籍数字数据生态系统的起点。

articles.title_en: Using LADM and BIM for property and tourist taxation in the municipality of Bar, Montenegro
articles.title_cn: 利用LADM和BIM进行黑山巴尔市财产税和旅游税征收
articles.abstract_en: Property valuation and taxation processes are of great importance, since revenues from taxes can be allocated to other areas of public interest thus improving the quality of life for all citizens. Two types of taxes are related to buildings and building units in Montenegro: property tax that is paid for all properties and tourist tax that is paid for properties used for tourism. Montenegro is a coastal country with rapid urbanization and developed tourism, so it is important to have well organized cadastral and tax administration records in order to perform correct tax calculation. Since the newly proposed LADM Valuation Information model is planned to be the part of the second edition of ISO 19152 Land Administration Domain Model (LADM), it is considered in the development of the country profile for valuation and taxation for Montenegro. The resulted model is presented in the paper. In addition to data organization, the procedures for determining the value of the property and tax value are also important and should be implemented according to the national regulation. In the paper, the formulas for calculation the tax values are presented. Appropriate attributes and classes that ensure keeping necessary data are added to the model. This model shows that LADM Valuation Information model can be used also for a very specific framework of legislation in which special kinds of property taxes can be found. The tax calculation in practice is not always correct due to lack of data. The possibility of using BIM model for new buildings in tax calculation, in order to overcome the mentioned problem, is analyzed. Data such as the area of the building and the quality of the building (building construction, building facade, windows, number of rooms, installations, number of bathrooms, etc.) can be directly loaded into tax administration database from the appropriate BIM model thus making the tax collection system more equitable and correct. In the paper, the mapping of appropriate BIM entities to valuation code lists are presented. In order to prove the benefits that such solution brings, an analysis of the cost-effectiveness of using BIM in the valuation and taxation process is carried out and presented.
articles.abstract_cn: 财产估值和征税过程非常重要，因为税收收入可以分配给其他公共利益领域，从而提高所有公民的生活质量。在黑山，与建筑物和建筑单元相关的税收有两种：对所有财产征收的财产税和对用于旅游的财产征收的旅游税。黑山是一个沿海国家，城市化进程迅速，旅游业发达，因此拥有组织良好的地籍和税务管理记录以进行正确的税收计算非常重要。由于新提出的LADM估值信息模型计划成为ISO 19152土地管理域模型（LADM）第二版的一部分，因此在为黑山制定估值和征税国家概况时考虑了该模型。本文介绍了由此产生的模型。除了数据组织外，确定财产价值和税收价值的程序也很重要，应根据国家法规实施。本文介绍了计算税收价值的公式。模型中添加了适当的属性和类，以确保保存必要的数据。该模型表明，LADM估值信息模型也可以用于非常具体的立法框架，其中可以找到特殊类型的财产税。由于数据缺乏，实践中的税收计算并不总是正确的。本文分析了在税收计算中使用BIM模型的可能性，以克服上述问题。诸如建筑物面积和建筑物质量（建筑施工、建筑立面、窗户、房间数量、安装、浴室数量等）等数据可以直接从适当的BIM模型加载到税务管理数据库中，从而使税收征收系统更加公平和正确。本文介绍了将适当的BIM实体映射到估值代码列表的过程。为了证明这种解决方案带来的好处，对在估值和征税过程中使用BIM的成本效益进行了分析并加以介绍。

articles.title_en: Trends in 3D cadastre – A literature survey
articles.title_cn: 三维地籍的发展趋势——文献综述
articles.abstract_en: The formation and alteration of real property and rights, restrictions and responsibilities are important parts of land administration. Research on the distribution of publications in the three-dimensional (3D) cadastral domain has been in focus as a specialised part of real property research during the last decades. A number of literature surveys on research trends in the domain show a growing number of publications during the last decades. The number of publications have increased considerably within a range of topics, classified into legal, technical, registration and organisational categories of 3D property. The purpose of the research presented here is to contribute to these analyses of the number and thematic distribution of the 3D cadastral domain literature by analysing three aspects: 1) To add to the recent study by including 3D cadastre publications published during 2021 (Paasch and Paulsson, 2021a, 2021b); 2) To briefly analyse the classification of 3D cadastre research in technical programmes and proceedings of major conferences focussing, in total or in part, on 3D cadastre. 3) The results are used to contribute to the discussion regarding if the 3D cadastral domain is too diverse today to talk about a single 3D cadastral domain. An input to the discussion of what constitutes a domain is provided from an analysis of another land administration research topic that is often addressed in relation to 3D real property research; the international standard for land administration, the Land Administration Domain Model, LADM, ISO 19152.
articles.abstract_cn: 不动产及其权利、限制和责任的设立与变更，是土地管理的重要组成部分。在过去几十年中，三维地籍领域出版物分布的研究作为不动产研究的一个专门部分一直受到关注。对该领域研究趋势的若干文献综述显示，近几十年来出版物数量不断增加。在三维不动产的法律、技术、登记和组织分类等广泛主题中，出版物数量显著增长。本文所呈现的研究目的是通过分析三个方面，为三维地籍领域文献的数量和主题分布分析做出贡献：1）通过纳入2021年发表的三维地籍出版物（Paasch和Paulsson，2021a，2021b），补充近期研究；2）简要分析主要会议技术方案和会议录中三维地籍研究的分类，这些会议全部或部分聚焦于三维地籍；3）利用结果参与讨论：如今三维地籍领域是否过于多样化，以至于无法谈论单一的三维地籍领域。通过分析另一个经常与三维不动产研究相关的土地管理研究主题，为讨论什么构成一个领域提供输入；该主题是土地管理国际标准，即土地管理领域模型（LADM），ISO 19152。

articles.title_en: The credibility thesis – A commentary from an original institutionalist position
articles.title_cn: 可信度论点——来自原始制度主义立场的评论
articles.abstract_en: This paper delivers an evaluation of the credibility thesis (CT) based on perspectives from original institutional economics. I first ask in what kind of explanation CT is grounded. Emphasizing functionality and denouncing intentionality, may indicate that it adheres to a functionalist type. At the same time, it does not seem to fulfil the criteria for such an explanation. CT explicitly refutes the idea of institutions in equilibrium. Second, I evaluate the proposal underlying CT that function supersedes form. I conclude that such a position cannot be generally defended. Form may even in some cases define what is understood as functional. Third, I therefore ask how to explain what institutions evolve and persist if they neither are chosen intentionally nor stabilized by functionalist mechanisms like an equilibrium. While there is definitive merit to the thesis and the research it has motivated, my analysis points towards a need for some reformulations.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文基于原始制度经济学的视角，对可信度论点（CT）进行了评价。我首先探讨CT基于何种解释类型。强调功能性并谴责意向性，可能表明它遵循功能主义类型。同时，它似乎并不满足这种解释的标准。CT明确反驳了制度处于均衡状态的观点。其次，我评估了CT所隐含的“功能超越形式”的提议。我得出结论，这种立场不能普遍得到辩护。在某些情况下，形式甚至可能定义了什么被视为功能性。第三，因此我探讨如何解释制度的演变与持续，如果它们既非有意选择，也非通过均衡等功能主义机制稳定下来。尽管该论点及其所激发的研究确有价值，但我的分析指出需要进行一些重新表述。

articles.title_en: What drives developers? Understanding vertical (dis)integration strategies in the land development process
articles.title_cn: 什么驱动开发商？理解土地开发过程中的纵向（去）整合策略
articles.abstract_en: Real estate developers play a crucial role in the production of our cities. Yet, the knowledge about how they operate is limited. They are often portrayed as a homogeneous group, while in practice we see a large variety of different types of developers and of their strategies. Particularly striking are the differences in the extent to which real estate developers cover the land development process. Some limit themselves to development, while others incorporate strategic land acquisition, construction, and/or long-term investment. With the help of theories from organisational economics, we explore different vertical integration strategies and the motives behind them. We apply these insights to cases from the Dutch homebuilding industry. Our analysis leads to a conceptualisation and categorisation of real estate developers according to their vertical integration strategy and we identify different motives behind those strategies. We find that vertical (dis)integration strategies are informed by strategic considerations, such as land assembly in order to secure future workload in construction, by price advantages, and by transaction-cost considerations that are related to the highly specific nature of some activities in the land development process.
articles.abstract_cn: 房地产开发商在我们城市的建设中扮演着关键角色。然而，关于他们如何运作的知识有限。他们常常被描绘成一个同质化的群体，而在实践中，我们看到不同类型的开发商及其策略存在巨大差异。尤其引人注目的是房地产开发商覆盖土地开发过程的程度差异。有些开发商仅限于开发，而其他开发商则整合了战略性土地收购、建设和/或长期投资。借助组织经济学的理论，我们探讨了不同的纵向整合策略及其背后的动机。我们将这些见解应用于荷兰住宅建筑行业的案例。我们的分析导致了对房地产开发商根据其纵向整合策略的概念化和分类，并识别了这些策略背后的不同动机。我们发现，纵向（去）整合策略受到战略考虑的影响，例如为了确保未来建设工作量的土地整合、价格优势以及与土地开发过程中某些活动的高度特定性相关的交易成本考虑。

articles.title_en: Legislative protection of agricultural land
articles.title_cn: 农业用地立法保护
articles.abstract_en: The agricultural land (AL) needs to be protected due to the steady growth of the global population and the demand for the food, living, work and recreation. The legislation in the area of AL protection in Slovakia has had almost 70-year tradition and 5 regulations with various effectivity of protection have been passed. These regulations reflect the social relations, technical advance, legal culture, as well as the experience of lawmakers. The basic characteristics for the land protection were defined by the social relations in the country. The first years are characterized by the collectivization of land, which changed the individual private farmsteads to collective. The alignment of public and private legal interests in the agricultural sector was disrupted by decisions of the Communist party and the scientific view on the concept of land protection conflicted with the political interests. This 40-year period caused a disruption of the relationship between the farmers and the land, which has not been restored up to the present day. The transformational era is characterized by a downfall of big state farms and a transformation to the market economy. The agrarian policy after 1990 was dominated by a conflict between the efforts to restore the private farmsteads from the era before 1950 and the need to preserve the big agricultural companies, which would be adequately competitive in the free market. The last era is linked to the accession of the Slovak Republic to the European Union in 2004. Since this year, the concept of land protection has been synchronized with the scientific, political and legislative perception of land in the international area and the land protection has been a subject of a vast legal regulation. The degree of land protection is a result of multiple laws and lower regulations and decrees and their synergic effect is expected in the practice. The paper analyses 5 regulations which are focused on the AL protection, and its aim is to quantify the legislative protection level between years 1951 and 2020. The value of agricultural land protection index (ALPI) is increasing with time and it reflects the weak and strong aspects of the protection in the context of social, economic, and ecological potential of the land. The analysis monitors 107 directive, control, and economic tools for AL protection. The results are presented in graphs and the relevant information is highlighted and explained. The results show the favourable evolution of the land protection in Slovakia. In the discussion, there is a space for the effectiveness assessment of the observed regulations, for the comparison of the objectives of the individual regulations and the practical results of the effect of these regulations on social relations. The statistics of the land evolution in the observed 70-year period are good indicators for this purpose. Since the analysis shows the negatives of the regulations, it provides new impulses and can be inspiration for the lawmakers. The method used for the regulation assessment or the comparison of regulations can be applied in various fields of science.
articles.abstract_cn: 由于全球人口稳步增长以及对食物、居住、工作和娱乐的需求，农业用地（AL）需要得到保护。斯洛伐克在农业用地保护领域的立法已有近70年的传统，并通过了5项具有不同保护效力的法规。这些法规反映了社会关系、技术进步、法律文化以及立法者的经验。土地保护的基本特征由国家中的社会关系所定义。最初几年以土地集体化为特征，将个体私人农场转变为集体农场。农业部门中公共和私人法律利益的协调被共产党的决定所破坏，关于土地保护概念的科学观点与政治利益相冲突。这40年的时期导致了农民与土地之间关系的破裂，这种关系至今尚未恢复。转型时期以大型国有农场的衰落和向市场经济的转变为特征。1990年后的农业政策以恢复1950年前私人农场与保留大型农业公司（这些公司在自由市场中具有充分竞争力）之间的冲突为主导。最后一个时期与斯洛伐克共和国于2004年加入欧盟有关。自那年起，土地保护的概念已与国际领域中对土地的科学、政治和立法认知同步，土地保护已成为广泛法律规制的主题。土地保护的程度是多项法律和下级法规及法令的结果，在实践中预期其协同效应。本文分析了5项专注于农业用地保护的法规，旨在量化1951年至2020年间的立法保护水平。农业用地保护指数（ALPI）的值随时间增加，反映了保护在土地的社会、经济和生态潜力背景下的弱点和优点。分析监测了107项针对农业用地保护的指令性、控制性和经济性工具。结果以图表呈现，并突出和解释了相关信息。结果显示斯洛伐克土地保护的有利演变。在讨论中，有空间评估所观察法规的有效性，比较各法规的目标以及这些法规对社会关系影响的实践结果。在所观察的70年期间，土地演变的统计数据为此目的提供了良好指标。由于分析显示了法规的负面因素，它为立法者提供了新的动力，并可能成为立法者的灵感。用于法规评估或法规比较的方法可应用于科学的各种领域。

articles.title_en: Land inequality and landlessness in Pakistan: Measuring the diverse nature of land disparities
articles.title_cn: 巴基斯坦的土地不平等和无地：衡量土地差异的多样性
articles.abstract_en: Measuring the precise nature and causes of land inequality is critical for addressing and implementing policy initiatives related to agricultural productivity, rural development and within-country income distribution. In this study, we argue that measuring land inequality solely among land owners does not provide a complete picture of land allocation among agricultural actors. We analyze land inequality (with or without the inclusion of landless peasants) as well as landlessness to present a holistic picture of land inequality across all districts of Pakistan. We employ data on 152,582 farm households from two rounds of the district-representative Pakistan Social and Living Standard Measurement Survey to construct Gini and Mean Logarithmic Deviation (MLD) indicators of land inequality and decompose it into within- and between-district inequalities. We found that inequalities measured without including landless peasants portray different picture of land disparities than that based on measures of inequality including landless workers. Our main findings are four-fold: 1) Land inequality measured including landless peasants is much higher (Gini = 0.84) than that without them (Gini = 0.67), and has increased much more between 2007 and 2015 when landless peasants are included (6%) than when measured without them (1%). 2) In 22% of the districts, land inequality without landless peasants decreased between 2007 and 2015 while that measured without them increased. The opposite is true in 5% of the districts. 3) Land inequality without landless workers is higher in irrigated and humid regions with better soil quality and rough terrain while inequality with landless workers is higher in more arid and semi-arid districts. Districts with rough topography face less landlessness in the presence of predominantly-smallholder farms, whereas more fertile soil is associated with higher landlessness. 4) Districts based on Pashtun tribal ancestral land distribution rights have the lowest rates of landlessness (20%) while districts with pre-colonial Zamindari-based land distribution show the highest incidence of landlessness (66%). The findings highlight the need for robust tenancy reforms in districts with humid climate, higher land inequality and lower landlessness in order to provide land tenure security to landless tenants and protect them from force eviction by powerful landed elites. Use of information technology in registering land rights through geo-coordinates can be helpful in improving land security and the expansion of the agricultural land markets. Besides, there is a greater need of land redistribution in the southern and south-western districts where landlessness is high despite relatively low extent of land inequality.
articles.abstract_cn: 衡量土地不平等的确切性质和原因对于解决和实施与农业生产力、农村发展和国内收入分配相关的政策举措至关重要。在本研究中，我们认为仅衡量土地所有者之间的土地不平等并不能提供农业参与者之间土地分配的完整情况。我们分析了土地不平等（包括或不包括失地农民）以及无土地情况，以呈现巴基斯坦所有地区土地不平等的整体情况。我们利用来自两轮地区代表巴基斯坦社会和生活水平测量调查的152,582农户数据来构建土地不平等的基尼系数和平均对数偏差（MLD）指标，并将其分解为地区内和地区间的不平等。我们发现，不包括失地农民在内的不平等衡量结果与基于包括失地工人在内的不平等衡量结果所描绘的土地不平等情况有所不同。我们的主要发现有四个方面：1）包括无地农民在内的土地不平等程度（基尼=0.84）比没有他们的土地不平等（基尼=0.67）高得多，并且在2007和2015之间，当包括无地农民时（6%）比不包括无地农民时（1%）增加更多。 2）在22%的地区，在2007和2015之间，没有失地农民的土地不平等有所下降，而没有失地农民的土地不平等则有所增加。 5% 的地区情况恰恰相反。 3）在土壤质量较好且地形崎岖的灌溉和潮湿地区，没有无地工人的土地不平等程度更高，而在较为干旱和半干旱的地区，无地工人的土地不平等程度更高。在小农农场占主导地位的情况下，地形崎岖的地区面临的失地情况较少，而土壤越肥沃则失地情况越严重。 4）基于普什图部落祖传土地分配权的地区无土地发生率最低（20%），而以前殖民时期扎明达里人为基础的土地分配地区无土地发生率最高（66%）。研究结果强调，需要在气候潮湿、土地不平等加剧和无地现象较少的地区进行强有力的租赁改革，以便为无地租户提供土地保有权保障，并保护他们免受强大的土地精英的强制驱逐。利用信息技术通过地理坐标登记土地权利有助于改善土地安全和扩大农地市场。此外，尽管土地不平等程度相对较低，但南部和西南部地区无地率较高，土地重新分配的需求更大。

articles.title_en: Brazil’s urban ecosystems threatened by law
articles.title_cn: 巴西城市生态系统受到法律威胁
articles.abstract_en: Brazil’s federal Law 12,651/2012 (popularly known as the “Forest Code”) requires “Permanent Preservation Areas”, known as “APPs,” which are strips of protected vegetation along the edges of watercourses. The widths of the strips vary, depending on the width of the watercourse, and the law applies to both rural and urban aquatic ecosystems. However, a recently approved law (14,285/2021) undermines the Forest Code by giving municipalities (counties) the attribution of defining the widths of the APPs. This even opens the possibility of eliminating urban APPs altogether if doing so is in the interest of the local administration. Reduction or elimination of APPs would result in numerous negative effects in aquatic ecosystems, which is problematic because ecosystems in cities harbor biodiversity. Therefore, a first needed step is revocation of Law 14,285/2021. Greater attention should be given to the conservation of both terrestrial and aquatic ecosystems in urban areas.
articles.abstract_cn: 巴西联邦法律第12,651/2012号（俗称“森林法”）要求设立“永久保护区”（简称“APP”），即沿水道边缘的受保护植被带。这些植被带的宽度根据水道的宽度而变化，该法律适用于农村和城市水生生态系统。然而，最近批准的一项法律（第14,285/2021号）削弱了森林法，赋予市政当局（县）定义APP宽度的权限。这甚至可能完全取消城市APP，如果这样做符合当地行政部门的利益。减少或取消APP将对水生生态系统产生许多负面影响，这很成问题，因为城市中的生态系统承载着生物多样性。因此，第一步需要废除第14,285/2021号法律。应更加关注城市地区陆生和水生生态系统的保护。

articles.title_en: Clarifying the EU objective of no net land take: A necessity to avoid the cure being worse than the disease
articles.title_cn: 澄清欧盟无净土地占用目标：避免治标不治本的必要性
articles.abstract_en: The European Union’s objective to stop land take by 2050 calls for a paradigmatic shift in urban development. While the reduction of land take may no longer be a matter for debate, the lack of clarity regarding the definition of the phenomenon and the way it should be monitored and tackled can nevertheless have counterproductive consequences. This paper highlights the importance of considering the degree of soil sealing in land take mitigation strategies, with the aim of ensuring that the EU objective is not achieved at the cost of the unsustainable intensification of land use within already artificial urban areas. The research relies on an analysis carried out of Europe’s 100 largest cities, in which the rates of soil sealing within the artificial areas of the urban morphological zones were measured. These rates range from 31.5 % to 72.6 %, underlining the diversity of contexts and the need for tailored approaches.
articles.abstract_cn: 欧盟到2050年停止土地占用的目标要求城市发展发生范式转变。虽然减少土地占用可能不再是一个有争议的问题，但对该现象的定义及其监测和处理方式缺乏明确性，仍可能产生适得其反的后果。本文强调了在土地占用缓解策略中考虑土壤封闭程度的重要性，旨在确保欧盟目标的实现不以牺牲已人工化城市区域内不可持续的土地利用集约化为代价。本研究基于对欧洲100个最大城市的分析，测量了城市形态区内人工区域的土壤封闭率。这些比率从31.5%到72.6%不等，凸显了背景的多样性以及采取针对性方法的必要性。

articles.title_en: Challenges of sporadic land registration in Palestine
articles.title_cn: 巴勒斯坦零星土地登记的挑战
articles.abstract_en: This research aimed to identify the challenges of sporadic land registration in the West Bank of Palestine. It recommended several legislative amendments based on problems identified by field research and comparative research. Following an intensive literature review, free discussions were conducted with a focused group of 19 experts in the West Bank to explore sporadic land registration related-problems. A quantitative questionnaire targeting a random sample of 202 persons who accomplished sporadic land registration transactions was conducted to identify their difficulties. In addition, legislative updates of some neighboring countries (Egypt and Jordan) have been highlighted to achieve the desired goals of the research. The research identified several legislative challenges for sporadic land registration in the West Bank. The conditions and procedures for sporadic land registration were issued in the sixties of the last century during the Jordanian rule of the West Bank and many military orders issued by the Israeli occupation authorities. The Palestinian Authority did not develop this legislation. Instead, it imposed high financial costs on citizens for land registration, contrary to the law's provisions. This paper recommended that the Palestinian Authority benefits from neighboring countries' experiences to facilitate sporadic land registration procedures and expenses.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究旨在识别巴勒斯坦西岸地区零星土地登记所面临的挑战。基于实地研究和比较研究中所发现的问题，本文提出了一些立法修正建议。在进行了深入的文献回顾之后，与西岸地区19名专家组成的焦点小组进行了自由讨论，以探索与零星土地登记相关的问题。针对已完成零星土地登记交易的202名随机样本人员进行了定量问卷调查，以识别他们遇到的困难。此外，还强调了邻国（埃及和约旦）的立法更新，以实现研究的目标。研究识别了西岸地区零星土地登记的若干立法挑战。零星土地登记的条件和程序是在上世纪六十年代约旦统治西岸时期颁布的，并且以色列占领当局发布了多项军事命令。巴勒斯坦权力机构并未发展这一立法，反而对公民的土地登记施加了高额财务成本，这与法律条款相悖。本文建议巴勒斯坦权力机构借鉴邻国的经验，以简化零星土地登记的程序和费用。

articles.title_en: Modeling the effects of carbon payments and forest owner cooperatives on carbon storage and revenue in Pacific Northwest forestlands
articles.title_cn: 建模碳支付与森林所有者合作社对太平洋西北部林地碳储存和收入的影响
articles.abstract_en: The forestlands of the Pacific Northwest store a significant amount of carbon, provide wildlife habitat, generate revenue for forestland owners, and provide for sustainable generation of forest products. Promoting forest carbon storage is increasingly recognized as a key management objective to mitigate climate change.
